reserveReview.rationale: Nest's live Available Vaults page reports server data loaded 2026-08-11, lists nTBILL's T+1 redemption estimate and current constituent categories (liquid assets, Janus Henderson Fund, and Superstate USTB), and renders mutable live weights that are intentionally not pinned here. Constituent-level look-through is admitted at limited quality only: Anemoy's JTRSY disclosure documents daily redemptions, a maximum six-month Treasury-bill maturity, and near-real-time holdings, while Superstate's USTB page documents short-duration Treasury Bills, market-day liquidity, and dated holdings as of 2026-07-24. Nest publishes no vault-level WAM, duration, or maturity aggregate, so no synthesized WAM/duration is recorded.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Nest live nTBILL vault disclosure and constituent fund disclosures
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The live page identifies the portfolio categories and named fund positions, but no durable allocation weights, stablecoin-buffer composition, custody-provider shares, vault-level WAM/duration, or maturity aggregate are retained in the reviewed sources.
